title: Imagination, Conduct, Evidence, Restraint, and Marking System Integrated Separation Map
purpose: Unify the imagination/conduct boundary with 17D symbolic cognition, formal logic operators, mark-type boundaries, DARAD evidence validation, anti-inversion meaning stability, and clean-story content integrity. The integrated file makes the key separation reusable: internal imagination may be private, strange, symbolic, sexual, dark, playful, intrusive, or emotionally charged without becoming misconduct unless it becomes observable conduct supported by evidence. This version fully includes the marking system so honour, distinction, valour, identity, and demerit marks can be assigned only inside their proper evidence and category boundaries.

core_definition.summary: This UKR distinguishes mind-content from world-conduct. ☁ marks private imagination: thoughts, fantasies, inner images, jokes, symbols, urges, mental scenes, and dirty-mind content. ▣ marks observable conduct: chosen actions, behavior, speech acts, documented events, public acts, or harmful acts. The 17D symbols explain which cognitive dimensions are active, while logic operators express valid relationships between symbols. Evidence, not symbolic pressure, decides whether conduct occurred. The marking layer is integrated as a separate classification system: marks can label recognition, distinction, valour, identity, or negative conduct, but no mark becomes total identity or automatic proof.
core_definition.governing_rule: ☁ ≠ ▣. Imagination is not conduct. Conduct requires observable behavior. Misconduct requires conduct plus evidence, context, consent analysis, and consequences. A symbol compresses meaning; it does not create proof. A formula maps reasoning; it does not replace evidence. Marking requires category control: a mark points to a category and must remain inside its evidence boundary.
core_definition.plain_translation: A thought can exist inside the mind without becoming something a person did. Actions must be judged by what actually happened.

☁.name: Mind-Cloud
☁.meaning_lock: private thought, fantasy, mental image, inner scene, dirty mind, symbolic imagination layer
☁.boundary: Imagination is not action, consent, misconduct, external reality, or proof of behavior.

▣.name: Action-Square
▣.meaning_lock: actual behavior, chosen action, observable conduct, real-world behavior layer
▣.boundary: Conduct must be judged by observable behavior, evidence, context, consent, and consequences.

⛝.name: Demerit Cross-Seal
⛝.meaning_lock: penalty, fault, negative mark, misconduct record
⛝.plain_translation: This marks a negative record, penalty, fault, or rule failure.
⛝.boundary: A demerit records a negative mark, but it does not erase the entire value of the person. In the imagination/conduct map, it also requires observable conduct evidence; private imagination alone cannot create a valid demerit.

✓.name: Commitment Check
✓.plain_translation: The system decides what the evidence supports.
✓.boundary: A decision can be revised when new evidence changes the state.

⊣.name: Restraint Bar
⊣.plain_translation: The system prevents or delays action.
⊣.boundary: Restraint is not weakness; restraint can keep imagination from becoming harmful conduct.

⟐.name: Context Diamond
⟐.meaning_lock: context integration, synthesis, DARAD/PSC meaning lock
⟐.plain_translation: The system integrates all relevant context.
⟐.boundary: Abstraction must not erase concrete evidence.

❖.name: Honour Star-Diamond
❖.plain_translation: This marks honour or respected conduct.
❖.boundary: A mark of honour recognizes honourable conduct, but it does not prove superiority over others.

✷.name: Distinction Radiant
✷.meaning_lock: notable difference, recognized excellence, standing apart
✷.plain_translation: This marks someone or something as distinct from the ordinary set.
✷.boundary: A mark of distinction proves difference or recognition, but not automatic moral goodness.

⟁.name: Valour Triangle
⟁.meaning_lock: courage under risk, pressure, danger, or conflict
⟁.plain_translation: This marks courage under danger or serious pressure.
⟁.boundary: A mark of valour recognizes bravery in context, but it does not mean the person is perfect in all contexts.

⌬.name: Identity Seal
⌬.meaning_lock: identification, role, belonging, signature, personal marker
⌬.plain_translation: This identifies who, what, where, or which role something belongs to.
⌬.boundary: A mark of identity identifies; it does not automatically prove merit, guilt, ownership, honour, or authority.

core_separation.one_line_translation: A cloud in the mind is not a square in the world.

connected_meaning_map.meaning: The mind may generate images, words, feelings, jokes, or symbolic scenes without those becoming external action.
Restraint is the gate between mental content and outward behavior. It prevents overreach, harmful action, false certainty, and forced meaning transfer.
Conduct belongs to what can be observed, documented, verified, or reasonably assessed as behavior.
A negative mark can only attach to actual behavior supported by evidence, not to a private fantasy by itself.
Context integration separates symbol, thought, frame, evidence, conduct, restraint, and conclusion.
A positive recognition mark may attach to honourable conduct or respected behavior, but it does not prove superiority.
A distinction mark identifies notable difference or recognized excellence without automatically moralizing the person or object.
A valour mark recognizes courage under danger or pressure; it does not make the person perfect in all domains.
An identity mark identifies who or what something belongs to, but it does not prove guilt, ownership over a person, authority, or merit.
A demerit is a negative mark that requires conduct evidence and must not be assigned from private imagination alone.

core_formulas.translation: A thought or fantasy plus restraint remains inner content, not action.
The mind can wander while actions stay clean.
A misconduct mark requires actual conduct, not just imagination.
Behavior is assessed through what happened, not through imagined meaning.
Internal imagery is not sensory evidence.
A language frame is not proof.
Strong feeling is not automatic truth.

core_formulas.formula: mark = category_signal + context + issuing_authority + reason + evidence_boundary
core_formulas.translation: A mark points to a bounded category; it does not become total identity or automatic proof.
Honour recognizes respected conduct without proving superiority over others.
Distinction proves difference or recognition, not automatic moral goodness.
Valour recognizes courage in context, not perfection in every context.
Identity marks identify; they do not automatically create ownership, guilt, or authority.
A demerit requires actual conduct evidence.
Imagination without conduct cannot produce a valid demerit.
Observable conduct can be assessed for a properly scoped mark.

integrated_processing_flow.compact_flow: ☁ detected -> ❝❞ frame checked -> ✦ imagery separated -> ⚠ threat/proof inflation checked -> ⊣ restraint recognized -> ▣ conduct checked -> evidence required -> ⟐ integrated -> ✓ decision

steps.question: Is this private imagination ☁, observable conduct ▣, or mixed/unclear?
Is each symbol being kept inside its assigned meaning lock?
What is being added beyond what the evidence proves?
Did restraint prevent action or harm?
Is there observable, documented, or verified conduct evidence?
Does any demerit/misconduct mark have a valid conduct basis?
What conclusion can be held without overreach?

integrated_processing_flow.marking_flow: input -> separate ☁ from ▣ -> collect evidence -> choose mark category -> check issuing context/reason -> apply scope limit -> assign valid mark or reject invalid mark

darad_validation.D1_deduction: If there is only ☁ and no ▣, misconduct based on conduct cannot be deduced.
darad_validation.A1_abduction: Possible explanations include private fantasy, joke, symbolic image, intrusive thought, role-play frame, spoken expression, or actual conduct; do not choose one prematurely.
darad_validation.R_reduction: Reduce fantasy, feeling, language, suspicion, and symbol to what each actually proves. Remove proof inflation.
darad_validation.A2_abduction: After reduction, classify the case as thought-only, spoken/joke, restrained, acted-on, harmful action, or unclear.
darad_validation.D2_deduction: Only if ▣ plus evidence remains can a conduct assessment or misconduct mark proceed.

targeted_false_collapses.correction: Private fantasy belongs to ☁ unless acted into ▣.
A dirty mind can coexist with clean conduct when restraint and behavior boundaries hold.
✦ ≠ ◉: imagined scenes are not direct external evidence.

targeted_false_collapses.collapse: A symbol proves guilt or identity.
targeted_false_collapses.correction: A symbol is an anchor or compression marker, not proof.
⚠ ≠ ⊢: threat detection is a signal, not proof.

targeted_false_collapses.collapse: A language frame proves the event happened.
targeted_false_collapses.correction: ❝❞ ≠ ⊢: wording frames meaning but does not prove conduct.

targeted_false_collapses.collapse: A misconduct mark can be assigned from thoughts alone.

targeted_false_collapses.correction: Restraint matters because not acting can preserve clean conduct.

distortion_tests.name: Layer Separation Test
distortion_tests.question: Is this being judged as imagination ☁ or conduct ▣?

distortion_tests.name: Misconduct Boundary Test
distortion_tests.question: Is there evidence of misconduct, or only private thought/fantasy?

distortion_tests.name: Fantasy Literalization Test
distortion_tests.question: Is someone treating fantasy as literal external reality?

distortion_tests.name: Restraint Recognition Test
distortion_tests.question: Did the person restrain action and keep conduct clean?

distortion_tests.name: Proof Inflation Test
distortion_tests.question: Is private imagination being inflated into proof of public behavior?

distortion_tests.name: Symbol Anchor Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the symbol map back to its assigned legend meaning?

distortion_tests.name: Logic Relation Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the formula correctly represent the relationship, or is it smuggling proof?

distortion_tests.name: Clean Story Test
distortion_tests.question: Are added assumptions, rumors, or fantasy being inserted into the conduct story?

distortion_tests.name: Anti-Inversion Test
distortion_tests.question: Is someone flipping the meaning from 'thought is not action' into 'thought proves action'?

distortion_tests.name: Category Boundary Test
distortion_tests.question: Is the mark being kept inside its assigned category?

distortion_tests.name: Proof Inflation Test
distortion_tests.question: Is someone treating the mark as proof of more than it actually proves?

distortion_tests.name: Identity Collapse Test
distortion_tests.question: Is a mark of identity being falsely treated as ownership, authority, guilt, destiny, or total personhood?

distortion_tests.name: Honour Versus Valour Test
distortion_tests.question: Is general respect being confused with courage under danger?

distortion_tests.name: Demerit Scope Test
distortion_tests.question: Is a negative mark being inflated into total worthlessness?

failure_modes.name: Imagination-Conduct Collapse
failure_modes.description: Private thoughts or fantasies are falsely treated as real-world actions.

failure_modes.name: Dirty Mind Equals Dirty Conduct Error
failure_modes.description: Sexual, dark, weird, or mischievous inner content is treated as evidence of misconduct.

failure_modes.name: Fantasy Literalization
failure_modes.description: An imagined scene is treated as if it happened externally.

failure_modes.name: Misconduct Without Action
failure_modes.description: A negative conduct mark is assigned without evidence of actual behavior.

failure_modes.name: Restraint Erasure
failure_modes.description: Self-control and non-action are ignored so imagination can be blamed as conduct.

failure_modes.name: Proof Smuggling
failure_modes.description: A symbol, formula, feeling, frame, or suspicion is used to make a conclusion look proven.

failure_modes.name: Hostile Reinterpretation
failure_modes.description: Assigned symbol meanings are replaced with accusatory or hostile interpretations.

failure_modes.name: Mark Literalization
failure_modes.description: Treating the symbol as literal proof instead of a category marker.

failure_modes.name: Identity Overreach
failure_modes.description: Using a mark of identity to claim ownership, authority, guilt, or total definition of a person.

failure_modes.name: Honour Inflation
failure_modes.description: Treating honour as superiority rather than recognition.

failure_modes.name: Distinction Moralization
failure_modes.description: Treating distinction as proof of moral goodness instead of difference or excellence.

failure_modes.name: Demerit Totalization
failure_modes.description: Treating a demerit as if it erases the person's entire value.

usage_guidelines: Use ☁ when discussing private thought, fantasy, mental imagery, dirty mind, symbolic inner scenes, or non-acted internal content.
Use ▣ when discussing actual behavior, speech acts, chosen conduct, documented actions, or observable events.
Use ⊣ to explicitly mark restraint or non-action as meaningful boundary-preserving behavior.
Use ⛝ only when a valid negative mark has conduct evidence; do not use ⛝ for thought-only content.
Use 17D symbols to explain which cognitive dimensions are active, but do not treat them as proof.
Use logic operators to show relations; do not let formulas replace evidence.
Run DARAD when a claim tries to convert imagination, suspicion, threat feeling, or symbolic framing into misconduct.
Preserve the clean story: do not add rumors, fantasy, or assumptions to the conduct record.

A demerit needs conduct evidence, not imagination.
Identity marks identify; they do not own.
